title: alchemilla vulgaris var. heteropoda
intro: Alchemilla vulgaris var. heteropoda, commonly known as Lady's Mantle, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the Rosaceae family, characterized by its rosettes of serrated leaves and yellowish-green flowers. The plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to soothe and calm digestive issues, reduce menstrual cramps, and alleviate symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Lady's Mantle include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and astringent properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lady's Mantle include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
